text:
Can you name the 3 things running along the underside of a rib? Think of a VAN 🚐
Intercostal space mnemonic: think of a VAN, top to bottom
V = Vein
A = Artery
N = Nerve
All three tuck into the costal groove along the lower edge of the rib.
Quick test: which one sits lowest? Answer in the video.
Save this for your next anatomy exam.
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Fig. 819, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume

pin_desc: Intercostal space mnemonic for anatomy class: think of a VAN, from the top down. V = vein, A = artery, N = nerve. All three run together in the costal groove along the lower edge of the rib, between the internal and innermost intercostal muscles.
